a node with no health entries reads reported: not-checked, verified: not-checked

a capability that is not healthy carries its reason in the annotated tree, and a healthy one none

an increment is parked already waiting for the owner, its note written in the parking's one write, so it is never open work without the wait; a wait the owner wait rules refuse, two for one releaser, or one on an increment born closed is refused with nothing written
arcViews() answers every live arc's view as arcView does, in a bounded number of reads whatever the number of arcs
the board's arcs: live arcs whole plus closed arcs whose closing day falls in a window, and closed arcs alone by a window, each with its closing day and only the increment fields the board draws

a work survey reads every live arc's state as arcViews does, its open questions counted and, unless closed, its title and priority; only open increments (and closed ones asked for by id) with the fields a dispatcher decides on, never a body; and the holds as holds() reads them
an increment moves to another live arc keeping its id, lifecycle and waits, the history recording the move and its reason; only open work moving to a closed arc is refused
an arc's intent and end state are required, and an arc written before they were is upgraded to carry them

an arc listing a story is returned by arcsFor(storyId), and an arc listing no stories is accepted; an arc listing a missing, retired or wrong-type story is refused, naming the first, with nothing written
a wait that would close a loop across arcs and increments is refused, naming the loop, and nothing is written
a wait is cleared from the record that stores it as its blocker lands (an increment) or closes (an arc), with the reason in its history; a failed or withdrawn blocker's wait stays
an arc waits on an increment of another arc: the wait holds the arc and its open work until that increment lands, and is cleared when it does

parking an increment whose capabilities list names one already on another open increment's list is refused, naming every such increment, its title and its arc in the one refusal, and the wait on that capability's claim as a way out, unless it is born waiting on that increment or on the claim of every capability they share

an increment is made to wait for the owner or an outside event with a note, one per releaser, the latest replacing it: an event wait needs a check-back day not before today, an owner wait takes none, and a closed increment waits for nothing; a refused wait is not written

an owner wait needs a why and may carry a rank, 1 first; each write stamps the instant it was read again (a stamp holding only a day still reads), and writing it again keeps the note, why and rank not given; an event wait takes neither

clearing an increment's event wait as a pull request it was handed over with merges stamps that pull request on its owner wait in the same write; writing the owner wait again drops it, and only an owner wait carries one

settling a question takes it off every increment's heldOn in the same step, keeping their other holds, and returns the open increments it released, by id and title, one held on it just before among them
retiring a question releases every increment held on it, open or closed, and retires it in one step

a failing verified verdict on a contract releases each open increment whose event wait is about it (one that links the contract or lists its capability): its event wait is cleared and the verdict written at the top of its body, in one write; a passing or not-checked verdict, an owner wait and an increment about other work are left as they were

a failing verdict told later, as of its place in history, releases only an increment whose event wait stood unchanged from that place to now: one made to wait, or made to wait again, after it keeps its wait
10.8 work reads stay small as unrelated closed history grows, preserving blockers and the arc log
${number} [${backend.label}] ${title}
a story, a capability under it and a contract under that come back from projectTree nested: story › capability › contract
a capability naming a missing or retired story is refused, as is a contract naming a missing capability
a capability depending on a capability that does not exist is refused
a dependency loop between capabilities, A → B → A or longer, is refused and nothing is written
a capability is born proposed; the agent switches the flag off, and back on, with its writer in history; one written before the flag reads proposed
a contract planned without a number gets its capability's next free one, and a number another live contract of the capability carries is refused
a capability planned without a number gets its story's next free one, so a contract planned on it moments later is numbered; a number given is kept
a contract planned without a number skips the numbers the capability's tests already carry; a number given is kept
a contract planned without a number never takes the number of a numbered test no live contract carries: it gets the next free number past it, and only a number given binds it to that test
a capability planned or retitled with a number another live capability of its story carries is refused, naming that one and the story's next free number; nothing is written
only mapStories makes an imported story: a mapped field given to addStory or editStory is refused and nothing is written
mapStories adds an imported story per new package, retires those of the same import whose package is gone, and leaves every other story as it stands
the plan's tree carries an imported story's import, package and folders as mapStories recorded them; a story storytree built carries none
a story planned with folders keeps them, editStory replaces them, the tree node carries folders and no mapped, and folders given with mapped or a blank folder are refused with nothing written
a number given in a contract's title without its separator is written as number then " · ", on planning and on correcting; a title already in that form is kept

a capability on an imported story is planned with the folders and files of its import it covers, several roots allowed and written plainly; one with none, or a path outside its story's folders, is refused, as are covers on a built story
no two capabilities of an imported story cover one file: a path equal to, inside or around another's is refused, naming the capability that covers it, on planning and on correcting

a capability carries the store links the mapping agent judged, each naming a store, a table, a direction and the file and line that sends the statement; one with no cite, a cite with no line, or another direction is refused with nothing written, a correction replaces them, and the plan's tree carries them
the project's anchor is written a half at a time, what it is and who it is for, at one id, and read back by anchor() and the plan's tree; an empty half is refused with nothing written
anchorGaps reads what the plan has not said, the anchor's missing halves only, and nothing when both are said; no story is ever named (ADR-1096)

a story carries no audience (ADR-1096): one given an audience is refused with nothing written, and one stored with an audience before reads without failing, its tree node carries none, and its next edit stores it without one
the plan's tree carries a story's risk reading and guardrails, and a capability's guardrails, as stored; one without them carries none

a contract may name the existing tests that prove it (provedBy, each a pytest node id or a test's title): addContract and editContract store them, projectTree gives them, and an empty list or name is refused

importPluginPlan writes a plugin's story, capabilities and contracts from its plan, adopting a live story the first time; a later import matches capabilities by number and contracts by theirs, edits what changed, adds what is new and retires what the plan no longer holds, keeping ids
a plugin's story, its capabilities and its contracts are refused every plan edit (story, capability, proposed flag, contract), each naming the plugin's plan; nothing is written

a plugin plan with a capability or contract carrying no number, a number twice, or a contract numbered under another capability is refused, as is adopting an imported story or another plugin's, with nothing written

an edge joins two live capabilities of one story and the dependent's dependsOn reads it: a same-story id in dependsOn becomes an edge and only another story's ids are stored; an edge across stories, to itself, twice, to no live capability or closing a loop is refused, with nothing written

an edge holds its own contracts: one added to an edge keeps a number given, a number another live contract of its story carries is refused, and one given none gets its dependent capability's next free number, past every number the story's contracts carry, which that capability never gives again; the tree lists it under the story's edge, never among either capability's contracts

moving a capability to another story turns its edges and its dependents' edges to it into stored dependsOn ids, and stored ids of its new story into edges; a dependsOn edit or move that would drop an edge holding contracts is refused, with nothing written

moveDependsOnToEdges moves every stored same-story dependsOn id onto an edge with no contracts, leaving another story's ids stored, and every capability's dependsOn reads back the same ids; a second run writes nothing
importPluginPlan writes a plan capability's same-story dependsOn as edges and another story's as stored ids; a re-import naming the same ids writes nothing

importPluginPlan given the numbers its plan's source ever held retires only a live capability or contract among them; any other (one another lane landed after the source was cut) stays live with its id and is reported left, not retired

importPluginPlan given the versions of its plan its source ever held edits a kept record's field only from a value one of them held; a field another lane changed since the source was cut stays as it stands and the record is reported stood

importPluginPlan given the versions its source held retires a live capability or contract under a held number only when its title is one that source held there; another lane's record under a number the source once held and renumbered stays live and is reported left

a contract moved to a numbered capability whose number its old one's prefix is not takes the new capability's next free number, past its contracts and tests; one given a title, or moved within its prefix, keeps its own

a contract may record how it is proved (proof: a test criterion or agentic user acceptance testing, with a one-line reason): addContract and editContract store it, projectTree gives it, and any other proof or an empty reason is refused

a plugin plan's contract may carry its proof: importPluginPlan writes it, changes it and, when the plan holds none, removes it; a proof another lane landed stands against a stale source; any other proof is refused with nothing written

a contract moved onto an edge, or retitled there, with a new title carrying no number keeps its own number; one with no number moved onto an edge gets its dependent capability's next free one, past its tests

a capability names a parent capability of its own story at any depth and keeps the story's next plain number; the tree carries its parent, a parent cleared makes it a top capability again, and a parent that is no live capability of its story, itself or one inside it is refused, as is moving to another story a capability with a parent or with capabilities inside it, with nothing written
a child capability planned or corrected with no folder with its own entry file or nested package behind its parent is refused, naming the parent and why; nothing is written
